{"consolidated_memory":"**services/auth/session_store.py - Request Timeout Issues (Two Separate Occasions)**

**OCCASION 1: 2026-01-17 - V1 SDK Clients**
- File: services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)
- Affected: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Problem: request timeout in the session store
- Signal: 30 second deadline in the gateway log
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR: #1080 on branch fix/request-timeout-1
- Repro: POST /login twice against a warm cache
- Test coverage: tests/auth/test_session_store.py
- Result: p99 latency fell from 5.6 s to 949 ms

**OCCASION 2: 2026-05-09 - High-Volume Tenants**
- File: services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)
- Affected: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Problem: request timeout in the session store
- Signal: 30 second deadline in the gateway log
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #6783 on branch fix/request-timeout-2
- Repro: POST /login twice against a warm cache
- Test coverage: tests/auth/test_session_store.py
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 59 days running

**Common Elements:** Both occurred in the same file on the authentication side, manifested the same signal and repro pattern, but were caused by different mechanisms and required distinct fixes."}
